requested_command:
set -eu
printf 'guest_utc='; date -u +%FT%TZ
printf '%s\n' '--- target packages (dpkg-query) ---'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}|${Version}|${Architecture}\n' libkylin-coreai-embedding kylin-ai-runtime kylin-gte-base-model kylin-ai-subsystem kylin-ai-parser-extension 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- SDK dpkg -L .so files ---'
dpkg -L libkylin-coreai-embedding 2>/dev/null | grep '\.so' || true
printf '%s\n' '--- SDK .so identity ---'
ls -l /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libkysdk-coreai-embedding.so* 2>/dev/null || true
sha256sum /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libkysdk-coreai-embedding.so.1.0.0 2>/dev/null || true
readelf -d /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libkysdk-coreai-embedding.so.1.0.0 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'SONAME|NEEDED' | head -25 || echo NO_READELF
printf '%s\n' '--- runtime package files ---'
dpkg -L kylin-ai-runtime 2>/dev/null | grep -E '/(bin|libexec)/' | head -40 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- runtime binary identity ---'
ls -l /usr/bin/kylin-ai-runtime 2>/dev/null || true
sha256sum /usr/bin/kylin-ai-runtime 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- model repository dirs ---'
find /usr/share/kylin-ai/model-repository -maxdepth 2 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort || echo MODEL_REPO_MISSING
printf '%s\n' '--- model canonical artifact sha256 ---'
find /usr/share/kylin-ai/model-repository/embd_gte-base_uint8-text /usr/share/kylin-ai/model-repository/ensemble-embd_gte-base_uint8-text /usr/share/kylin-ai/model-repository/tokenizer_gte-base_uint8-text -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.onnx' -o -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.py' \) -exec sha256sum {} + 2>/dev/null | sort -k2 || echo NO_MODEL_ARTIFACTS
printf '%s\n' '--- installed package count ---'
echo total_installed=$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}\n' 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^install ok installed')
printf '%s\n' '--- full dpkg-query -W package baseline (sorted) ---'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\t${Version}\t${Architecture}\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
